name: com.burgeonads/oracles
title: Deterministic Constraint Oracles
description: Verified stateless SMT-LIB2 and CP-SAT. No API key or account required. Zero-logging execution.

tools.name: analyze_regex
tools.description: Decide regular-language equivalence, generate shortest diff witnesses and samples, and prove static backtracking ambiguity. Reference: oracle://docs/verification-oracles.

tools.name: solve_smt
tools.description: Solve SMT-LIB2 constraints. Returns an independently verified model or minimal unsat core. Reference: oracle://docs/constraint-oracle.

tools.name: solve_cpsat
tools.description: Solve CP-SAT integer constraints and optimization. Returns an independently verified solution. Reference: oracle://docs/constraint-oracle.

tools.name: analyze_rules
tools.description: Analyze ordered JSON rules for unreachable rules, overlaps, gaps and action differences. Independently replays every witness. Reference: oracle://docs/verification-oracles.

tools.name: verify_state_machine
tools.description: Check bounded state machines with deterministic BFS and independently replayed shortest counterexamples. Reference: oracle://docs/verification-oracles.
